ai_summary: MIUI individual (personalized) auto-brightness plug-in. A single 197,836-byte TFLite flatbuffer (assets/aiautobrt.tflite) contains two 3->3->128->64->1 ReLU MLPs ('dnn_model' teacher and 'dnn_model_1' student) plus the full TF1 training graph. The exported AIDL service com.miui.aiautobrt.service.IndividualModelService answers predictBrightness() with the 'old_model_infer' signature, fed with [ln(ambientLux+1), ln(ambientLuxSpan+1), ln(appCategoryId+1)]; the result is the predicted screen brightness. Every onEventChanged() call appends a row to the Room table brightness_model_event. A JobScheduler job (93197, 24 h, idle) runs TrainJobService -> i3.a, which trains the student for up to 5 epochs of batch 128 on a 90/10 split with loss = 0.9*MAPE(label, student) + 0.1*MAPE(teacher, student) and a TF1 AdamOptimizer (lr 0.001, beta1 0.9, beta2 0.999, eps 1e-7); if the student beats the teacher on the held-out 10 % it is written to filesDir/checkpoint under both variable name sets ('save_for_replace') and restored, and it is promoted only if it is not worse than the stock brightness curve in all four brightness buckets (<8, 8-50, 50-200, >=200). Weights are plain float32 constants in the flatbuffer's CALL_ONCE init subgraph - extracted byte-exact and matched numerically by a JAX reimplementation (max relative error 4.8e-7). The device-side half was also recovered (miui-services.jar / miui-framework.jar): system_server builds the event with raw physical units (lux, lux bucket 0..44, app category 0..9, brightness in nits), calls the service through five all-oneway AIDL transactions, and uses the predicted nits only to rebuild a per-app-category lux->backlight spline after training; the live brightness path interpolates that persisted spline, so the model is never invoked per brightness change.

features.name: Individual auto-brightness prediction (serving path)
pipeline: framework binds service action com.miui.aiautobrt.service.AiService and calls provideInterfaceVersion(int)
predictBrightness(event) is ignored (event brightness returned) unless interface version >= 2
f3.c.a builds h3.a: ln(lux+1), ln(luxSpan+1), ln(appCategoryId+1), ln(mixedOrientationApp+1), cur_brt, cur_brt_span, curve_brt
g3.a.a copies only the first three values into float[1][3] and runs signature 'old_model_infer' with output 'pre' (FloatBuffer(1))
on IllegalArgumentException the helper returns -1.0f and the caller falls back to event.getCurrentBrightness()
prediction is logged and returned via onPredictFinished(ambientLux, appCategoryId, brightness)
features.notes: Only the old_model_infer signature serves predictions; new_model_infer is used only for validation inside the training job.

features.name: Brightness event logging (training data collection)
pipeline: onEventChanged is accepted only when interface version >= 2
event -> h3.a (8 fields) and inserted into Room table brightness_model_event
the DAO keeps at most 50000 rows (deletes 10000 oldest per trim) and resets sqlite_sequence on clear
features.notes: DB file AiBrightnessModel.db (gb.c.g(Room.databaseBuilder)); schema brightness_model_event(mId, ambient_lux, ambient_lux_span, orientation_and_app_industry, app_code, cur_brt, cur_brt_span, curve_brt), all REAL except mId INTEGER PK.

features.name: On-device re-training and model replacement
pipeline: training requires interface version >= 2 and >= 10000 new events (or force_train_enable=1 and >= 1000)
events split 90/10 train/validation after shuffling; up to 5 epochs, batches of 128
each batch: x[128,3] = [ln(lux+1), ln(luxSpan+1), ln(appCat+1)], y[128,1] = cur_brt; signature 'train' returns loss
loss = 0.9*MAPE(train_y, student) + 0.1*MAPE(teacher, student), MAPE = mean(100*|(t-p)/max(|t|,1e-7)|)
optimizer = TF1 unfused Adam (lr 0.001, beta1 0.9, beta2 0.999, eps 1e-7, lr_t bias-corrected, iter incremented after the step); gradients only for dnn_model_1/*
validation MAPE vs cur_brt: if student < teacher -> 'save_for_replace' writes the student weights under all 16 checkpoint keys, then 'restore' reloads them
promotion also requires student MAPE <= stock curve MAPE in all four brightness buckets (8/50/200) or debug.miui.display.dbg bit 128
on promotion: onTrainFinished callback, DB cleared, offset reset; onTrainIndicatorsFinished(IndividualTrainEvent) always fired
features.notes: The 'save' signature (subgraph 3) is never called by this APK's Java code.

features.name: AB-test / experiment hook for the brightness feature
pipeline: y6/z6 AB-test SDK polled with app name '<ro.product.mod_device>_individual'
result passed to f3.c.e, which forwards Settings.Secure custom_brightness_mode as the value override when non-zero
features.notes: No model/graph involvement; included because it can override the brightness value handed to the framework.

features.name: Two-stage model activation via framework-side spline reconstruction
entrypoints: system_server: uploadValidatedEventToModel -> predictBrightness x (mDefaultLuxLevels x categories 0,1,2)
pipeline: training_accepted -> onTrainFinished callback
sweep predictBrightness over a device lux grid for app categories 0/1/2 (200 ms pacing, 200 ms timeout per point)
smoothCurve: clamp to [mMinBrightness, mNormalMaxBrightness], max ratio ((lux+0.25)/(prevLux+0.25)), min step 0.004 backlight
checks: monotonic, >= minimum brightness spline, slope >= 100/(hbmMinLux-1)
Spline.createSpline(luxLevels, nits) per category + persist to /data/system/displayconfig/custom_brightness_backup.xml
live: spline.interpolate(lux) -> getBrightnessFromNit -> clampScreenBrightness -> mScreenAutoBrightness
features.notes: The predicted brightness is not applied per event. It is converted into a per-app-category lux->backlight curve that the AOSP auto-brightness loop interpolates. A manual brightness adjustment invalidates the model (reason 'user_operate') until the next successful training. Verified in miui-services.dex / services.dex, not in the APK.

models.verification: Inference (subgraphs 0 and 1) matches ai_edge_litert over 256 app-domain + 128 wide-range + single-row + zero inputs: max relative error 4.8e-7 (new) and 3.6e-7 (old); exported old-model output range 3.86 (lux 0) .. 1734.9 (lux 50000). Training step cross-checked against an independent NumPy transcription (weights agree to 1.5e-8 after 8 steps) and float64 central differences (max |d| 1.6e-9); it cannot be run through ai_edge_litert 2.3.0 because subgraph 5 needs FlexBroadcastGradientArgs/FlexSign/FlexReluGrad from libtensorflowlite_flex_jni.so.

reimplementation.limitations: Inference is numerically verified against the LiteRT interpreter with the byte-exact flatbuffer weights. The train subgraph is reimplemented (loss, backprop, TF1-Adam) and cross-checked against a NumPy transcription plus finite differences, but not against the reference interpreter because ai_edge_litert 2.3.0 lacks the Select-TF (Flex) delegate required by FlexBroadcastGradientArgs/FlexSign/FlexReluGrad; no TensorFlow package is available offline. Subgraphs 2/3/4 (FlexRestore/FlexSave checkpoint I/O) are documented but not reimplemented.

unknowns: The com.xiaomi.aiautobrt AIDL types are not in the APK, but they were recovered from the device image (system_ext/framework/miui-framework.jar): transactions are 1 onEventChanged, 2 predictBrightness, 3 attach, 4 detach, 5 provideInterfaceVersion, all oneway. `IIndividualBrightnessService` is resolved; see PIPELINE.md section P1.2 and evidence/framework_paths.txt.

Field semantics were resolved on the framework side (BrightnessDataProcessor.createModelEvent): ambient_lux = physical lux (ring-buffer weighted sensor mean); ambient_lux_span = bucket index 0..44 from getAmbientLuxSpanIndex; app_code = appCategoryId 0..9 (AppClassifier); cur_brt = nits via getNitsFromBacklight; cur_brt_span = bucket index 0..44 from getBrightnessSpanByNit; curve_brt = nits from the stock/config spline; orientation_and_app_industry = getMixedOrientApp in {0,1,2} and is not fed to the model. Still unknown: the exact numerical value of the framework-res horizons/light-sensor rate and the lux grid used by the post-training validation sweep.
Whether production builds ever set the debug props force_train_enable / debug.miui.display.dbg and what the AB-test payload (f3.c.e) actually controls.

Device-specific checkpoint contents: the packaged asset contains an untrained student (zero biases, zero Adam slots); a device that has trained holds different weights in filesDir/checkpoint, which is not part of the APK.
Why the shipped teacher's first layer is 3->3 (bottleneck) - no documentation in the APK.
Whether the hard-coded job id 93197 / 24 h period is overridden by MIUI power-management policy at runtime.

transport.mode: oneway for all five (Proxy: transact(code, data, null, 1))
transport.payload: IndividualModelEvent Parcelable: curBrt, curBrtSpan, lux, luxSpan, defaultConfigBrt, appCategoryId, orientation, mixedOrientationApp, timeStamp
transport.binding: action com.miui.aiautobrt.service.AiService via bindServiceAsUser(currentUser, flags=67108865 = BIND_AUTO_CREATE|BIND_FOREGROUND_SERVICE); attach(cb) + provideInterfaceVersion(2); linkToDeath
transport.threading: caller system_server display thread; callee runs TFLite synchronously on the Binder thread (no queue/worker); callback re-posted to mBgHandler

input.builder: f3.c.a(IndividualModelEvent) -> h3.a; g3.a.a(sig, h3.a) copies fields c, f4046d, f4048f
input.ambientLux: physical lux, mAmbientLux of AOSP AutomaticBrightnessController (ring-buffer weighted mean)
input.unused_fields: currentBrightness (nits), currentBrightnessSpan (bucket), defaultConfigBrightness (nits), orientation, mixedOrientationApp are carried but not model inputs
input.cadence: event-driven: every settled brightness change of type 1/2, 3000 ms debounce; no periodic sampling
input.units: log of physical units; no normalization on the model path (normalizeLux/normalizeNit unused)

model.runtime: TFLite Interpreter over an mmapped asset, one session per process
model.weights: subgraph-6 CALL_ONCE constants, optionally overwritten by filesDir/checkpoint restore

output.description: predicted brightness in nits (label domain: cur_brt = getNitsFromBacklight)
output.app_postprocessing: raw pre[0]; error sentinel -1.0f -> event.getCurrentBrightness() fallback
output.framework_postprocessing: reject NaN/<0; getBrightnessFromNit; sweep over mDefaultLuxLevels x categories {0,1,2} at 200 ms; smoothCurve (clamp + max slope ratio 1.0 + min step 0.004); monotonicity, minimum-spline and minimum-slope checks; Spline.createSpline per category
output.note: the model is NOT invoked per live brightness change; only the derived spline is used, so the predicted value reaches the display through a per-category lux->backlight curve
output.persistence: /data/system/displayconfig/custom_brightness_backup.xml (AtomicFile, enabled flags + 3 spline arrays), restored at boot without the APK
output.user_selection: Settings.Secure custom_brightness_mode via getIntForUser(...,-2): 0 off, 1 custom curve, 2 individual model

fallback.model_missing: g3.a logs and marks itself invalid; stub returns event.getCurrentBrightness()
fallback.interface_version: app requires f3605e >= 2, else returns the event brightness
fallback.service_unbound: event is dropped and a bind is attempted
fallback.validation: 200 ms per-point timeout or non-monotonic / below-minimum curve -> model not promoted, previous curve kept
fallback.no_spline: getCustomBrightness falls through to the custom curve, then to the stock/config mapper

data_pipelines.name: P2 on-device training job
entrypoints: i3.a.run: query -> split -> 5 epochs x 128 -> validate -> save_for_replace/restore -> bucket check -> callbacks

transport.batches: float[128][3] x = {c, f4046d, f4048f}; float[128][1] y = cur_brt (nits); output loss FloatBuffer(1)
transport.signature: train (x, y -> loss), one Adam step per call
transport.thread: plain Thread started by onStartJob; jobFinished(params, false) at the end

input.source: Room table brightness_model_event in AiBrightnessModel.db (schema v1, 8 columns)
input.query: SELECT * FROM brightness_model_event LIMIT -1 OFFSET <f3604d> (no ORDER BY)
input.trigger: new rows >= 10000, or Settings.Secure force_train_enable == 1 with >= 1000 new rows
input.preprocessing: ln(x+1) features are already materialised at ingestion; training reuses the stored values

model.hyperparameters: <= 5 epochs, batch 128, tail batch re-uses the last 128 samples, TF1 Adam lr 0.001 beta1 0.9 beta2 0.999 eps 1e-7

output.validation: newMAPE vs oldMAPE on the held-out 10%
output.checkpoint: save_for_replace writes all 16 TF keys from the 8 student variables, then restore reloads them (filesDir/checkpoint prefix)
output.bucket_check: |cur - defaultConfigBrt| vs |cur - old_pred| accumulated in 4 cur_brt buckets {<8, 8-50, 50-200, >=200}; accept iff not worse in all four, or debug.miui.display.dbg bit 128
output.accept_callbacks: IIndividualCallback.onTrainFinished() then DB wipe (DELETE + sqlite_sequence.seq = 0); always onTrainIndicatorsFinished(IndividualTrainEvent)
output.activation: two-stage: weights swap in-process at restore; the user-visible curve changes only after the framework sweep passes and setModelValid(true, 'train_finished') persists the splines

fallback.model_unavailable: Lite model is not available! -> skip
fallback.train_error: IllegalArgumentException per batch -> loss 1.0, batch skipped
fallback.bucket_reject: no onTrainFinished, weights remain swapped in the app process but the framework keeps the old curve
fallback.job_stopped: onStopJob returns false (no retry); the training thread is not interrupted

persistence.versioning: none: AIDL interface version 2, Room schema 1, freshness = in-memory row offset f3604d
